reviewMethod: Official KiKA metadata, full local small/base ASR, independent medium ASR of16–185seconds, word timing and visual contact sheet. No native-human full listening approval.

decisions.reason: Opening song, with substantial ASR disagreement.
Repeated opening-song callback question is less useful than the following spoken concern.
Medium recognizes discourse particle denn; small/base normalize as dann. Frame shows narrator asking what is wrong with the bear.
Small and medium agree dein Honigtopf ist weg; normalize compound spelling Honigtopf.
Visual bee and bear, official story metadata and medium confirm Biene/Bär; small/base Bina/Berg are recognition spellings.
Small/medium agree greeting to Esel, possessive Honigtopf search and location question.
Keep location statement and thanks as individual cues; omit incidental Ah/Oh exclamations.
Three models disagree on wording of pot ownership; do not infer the phrase solely from plot.
Small/base recognize ist; medium writes homophone isst. Context is confirming the previously indicated location of the missing masculine Honigtopf.
Small/medium agree whole eating question. Bären/Beeren are homophones; referent is visually the bear, also established in official synopsis.
Visual companions and small/base/medium phonetics support Biber and Esel.
Small geschleckt vs base/medium geschlägt; uncertain inflection/ownership wording is not taught.
allen/einem pronoun disagreement in apology sentence.
Models disagree on the spoken construction for obtaining honey.
Small/medium agree Das ist lieb, Biene; omit preceding interjection.
Long explanation of collecting honey has major small/base/medium word disagreements.
All three models agree Das Leben ist so schön; following conditional clause and final tag question are omitted due disagreement.
Closing song and credits. Complete source video is retained.
